test_name: Verify Navigation to Documentation via Footer
description: Tests the ability of a user to access the Roost documentation by clicking the footer link.
steps: Scroll down to the footer section.
Verify the visibility of the 'Documentation' link.
Wait for the https://docs.roost.ai page to load.
Verify the title and content of the documentation page.
expected_results: User is redirected to the documentation page.
Documentation page content is loaded correctly.
edge_cases: Documentation link is not visible in the footer.
Clicking the link does not redirect to the documentation page.
Network issues prevent navigation to the documentation page.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the documentation page.
dependencies: User has access to the internet.
performance_metrics: Redirection time to the documentation page.
Time taken to load the documentation page content.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Documentation' link is labeled appropriately for screen readers.
Verify color contrast ratios for the link text.
Test keyboard accessibility for the link.
